contract.endpoint_intersection_policy: left-freeze endpoint categories on the full M2 object, then restrict scoring to common contract targets

numerical_rules.nonestimable_policy: record NA, status, and estimable target count; do not impute zero

total_shift_endpoint_alignment.target_score: mean absolute predicted shift across the 47 response genes
total_shift_endpoint_alignment.context_summary: Spearman rho with DepMap dependency probability
total_shift_endpoint_alignment.scale_property: rank-invariant to positive global model scaling

directional_response_recovery.target_score: signed cosine between predicted and observed shift vectors
directional_response_recovery.direction: higher is better; +1 aligned, 0 orthogonal, -1 negated

endpoint_anchor_separation.scale_property: rank-invariant to positive global model scaling

target_identity_preservation.target_score: off-diagonal observed and predicted target-by-target cosine similarity matrices
target_identity_preservation.context_summary: Spearman rho of aligned lower triangles
target_identity_preservation.inference: one-sided Mantel-style permutation of predicted target labels

output_homogenization.context_summary: mean off-diagonal cosine among predicted target vectors
output_homogenization.observed_reference: same statistic among observed target vectors
output_homogenization.primary_warning: predicted minus observed uncentered mean off-diagonal cosine
output_homogenization.centered_sensitivity: subtract across-target gene-wise mean before cosine and report predicted, observed, and difference
output_homogenization.direction: higher positive excess is a warning, not better performance

secondary_metrics.absolute_response_axis_projection: absolute dot product of prediction with the observed unit vector; magnitude-retaining and not directional
secondary_metrics.signed_response_axis_projection: signed dot product of prediction with the observed unit vector; magnitude-retaining
secondary_metrics.predicted_shift_l2: L2 norm of predicted shift; descriptive

conventional_reconstruction.context_summary: target median with target bootstrap percentile 95% CI
conventional_reconstruction.top_k_overlap: secondary only if k is fixed before result inspection

observed_magnitude_random_direction.definition: independent standard-normal direction per target, normalized to the observed target L2 norm

shared_mean_baseline.definition: existing scorer-ready canonical-backbone observed-shift mean repeated for every target

inference.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each prespecified metric family for real entrants; reference-control behavior is calibration and reported without leaderboard ranking
